answer_1.quote: We propose a new task, Multimodal Input Multimodal Output Question Answering (MIMOQA)... We propose MExBERT, a novel multimodal framework for extracting multimodal answers to a given question...
answer_1.outputs: multimodal answer consisting of a textual span and a selected image

answer_2.quote: For the text, we considered standard metrics like ROUGE, BLEU... For images, we use the precision @1,2 and 3... We observe that Rouge-1, Rouge-2, Rouge-L and BLEU yielded a correlation... precision@1 was most strongly correlated with human judgement.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a Mechanical Turk experiment where the turkers were asked to select an image... Every question-answer pair was annotated by 5 annotators... annotators were asked to rate the quality of both textual and image part of the answer on relevance R and user satisfaction S.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators rated each answer on relevance and user satisfaction, and indicated whether the image enhanced understanding.
